notes: Governing documents: the UC Academic Personnel Manual (APM 760, 715, 710, 133, 700, 759) is the system-wide policy for UC Santa Cruz academic appointees; the CAPM 900.700 and the APO family-care page are campus summaries that defer to the APM ('governed by the terms of the applicable Academic Personnel Manual policies'). missing = false: APM 760 is a parental-leave policy covering tenure-stream (ladder-rank, Academic Senate) faculty.

Reference date 2018-02-28. APM 760 pages carry Rev. 1/1/06 (760-30 Rev. 9/1/15), captured 2018-05-18; APM 133 Rev. 9/1/15 captured 2017-03-09; campus pages last modified August 2017. All taken as in force on the reference date.

Calendar: UCSC is on quarters (CAPM: Fall to Spring quarter; 'one quarter of Active Service-Modified Duties'); term length not stated, so calendar.kind = quarter, and the term length follows R8's order. The APM's quarter alternatives are coded.
Saved statute texts are 2026 versions; the lengths the APM states (FMLA and CFRA 12 workweeks; PDL up to 4 months) match them, so statute_verified = true.

Birth parent chain: childbearing leave paid up to 6 weeks (c2), inside the PDL of up to 4 months (c1) and FMLA 12 workweeks (c4) from the birth, all within ASMD of two quarters in total (c8, which contains c2) -> after the PDL: CFRA 12 workweeks (c5) running with parental leave without pay of up to 1 year (c6); paid medical leave (c17/c18, also available, 'in addition to' childbearing leave) then discretionary unpaid medical leave (c19); everything capped at one year per event (leave_limits).

Non-birth parent chain: ASMD of one quarter at regular salary (c8) and parental leave without pay of up to 1 year (c6) from the birth, with FMLA (c4) and CFRA (c5) 12 workweeks running concurrently with the parental leave, and discretionary FMLA pay (c7) within FMLA; capped at one year per event.

Paths and conditions: ASMD requires responsibility for 50% or more of the child's care (c8); the birth mother's two-quarter total requires a full-time appointment for a full academic year, met by the two-year member (U8). Paid medical leave steps up to 3 quarters after 10 years of UC service (duration_max).
